Rank RSS and whole-step time remain separate gates; final lifecycle and granularity are unchanged.

rhs.scope: Authoritative RHS retained by real resident RK; old Domain RHS and capture entry guards active. Local/cluster science gates are separate. RK adapter counts include raw five-field bounded reader values and five-field resident deliveries (only temperature installed). Input/derived counters exclude topology preparation and metadata; whole-step timing includes all costs. No speedup claim.

publication.limitation: Actual installation calls counted on every rank and asserted at each Stage203 exit; per-transaction logging occurs only in the oracle.

optimized.scope: Three provisional transitions per step. Fixed kernel records are work descriptors, not FLOPs or time weights. Production bypasses the old complete WT path; oracle runs compare old outputs and restore candidate SOL for real consumers. Traffic excludes metadata and epoch headers; route invocations are not global synchronization rounds. Memory is named numerical/route payload, excludes kernel/geometry metadata, descriptors, compilation peak, retained final-transform workspace and MPI. Rank RSS and whole-step time remain separate gates; final lifecycle and granularity are unchanged.
